why: 结论 29: the authoritative copy of a session's transcript is the platform's, handed up incrementally before each turn ends. What makes that a property of the turn rather than of a timer is this event — hook delivery landing is what sends the collector at once instead of on its five-second clock (app/domain/agent/event_drain.py, whose upload path tests/unit/test_transcript_collector.py drives end to end). So the contract's share here is that every harness says 「这一轮结束了」 in a way the platform recognises, and says what the agent said last. Claude Code's records are two flushes of ONE message, which is the shape its stream really has: a message is whole at a protocol boundary, not at every flush, so the two must come out as one event here exactly as the other two harnesses' single records do.
